name: Tushen Aikin Saka Fanalan Hasken Rana (Solar)
objectives: Idan aka ba ku zane ko jerin sassan tsarin solar na gida da ke haɗe da grid, faɗin sunan kowane babban sashe da abin da yake yi, kuna samun aƙalla sassa 5 cikin 6 daidai
Idan aka ba ku labarin aikin solar na atisaye, jera haɗurran da matakin tsaro na kowanne, kuna ambaton faɗuwa, girgizar lantarki, zafi da ɗaukar kaya, da matakin tsaro daidai na kowanne
Idan aka ba ku lambobin atisaye na fanalai, volt da amp, lissafa watt, girman tsari da voltage na string, ba tare da kuskuren lissafi ba, kuna nuna yadda kuka yi
Idan aka ba ku matakan saka solar a kan rufi a gauraye, jera matakan bisa tsari da faɗin wanda yake yin kowanne, ba tare da mataki fiye da ɗaya ya kauce wurinsa ba
Ta amfani da shafukan intanet na hukuma na NABCEP da na jiharku, jera takardun shaida da lasisin da ake buƙata don aikin solar na farko a inda kuke zaune, kuna ambaton shafin majiyar kowanne
Ta amfani da rubuce-rubucenku daga wannan kwas, rubuta Shirin Fara Aikin Solar mai ranaku da sashen ƙwarewa na résumé, kuna cika kowane layi na ma'aunin rubric

chapters.name: Babi na 1: Yadda solar ke aiki da yadda ake kasancewa lafiya

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Sassan tsarin solar na gida
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Faɗin sunayen manyan sassan tsarin solar da ke haɗe da grid da abin da kowanne yake yi.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku zane ko jerin sassan tsarin solar na gida da ke haɗe da grid, za ku iya faɗin sunan kowane babban sashe da abin da yake yi, kuna samun aƙalla sassa 5 cikin 6 daidai.
Fanalan solar, wanda ake kira modules, suna mayar da hasken rana zuwa wutar lantarki. Irin wutar da suke yi ita ce DC (direct current). Gidaje suna amfani da AC (alternating current), don haka inverter yana mayar da DC zuwa AC.
Fanalan suna zaune a kan racking, wato firam na ƙarfe da aka ƙulle a kan rufi ko aka kafa a ƙasa. Wayoyi suna tafiya daga fanalan zuwa inverter, sannan zuwa babban akwatin wutar lantarki na gidan. Maɓallan katsewa (disconnect) suna bar ma'aikata su kashe wasu sassan tsarin. Mita tana ƙirga wutar da gidan ke amfani da ita da wadda yake turawa zuwa grid.
Yawancin tsarin gidaje suna haɗe da grid (grid-tied): suna nan a haɗe da layukan kamfanin wutar lantarki, wanda ake kira grid. Ƙarin wuta yana iya gudana zuwa grid, kuma gidan yana amfani da wutar grid da dare. Wasu gidaje kuma suna ƙara batir don ajiye wuta don gaba ko lokacin da wuta ta ɗauke.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Fanalin solar (module): fanali mai faɗi da ke mayar da hasken rana zuwa wutar lantarki.
- PV (photovoltaic): fasahar da ke yin wutar lantarki daga haske; fanalan solar fanalan PV ne.
- DC (direct current): wutar lantarki da ke gudana ta hanya ɗaya, kamar daga batir ko fanalin solar.
- AC (alternating current): wutar lantarki da ke canja hanya sau da yawa a cikin daƙiƙa ɗaya; gidaje suna amfani da AC.
- Inverter: akwatin da ke mayar da DC daga fanalan zuwa AC don gidan.
- Racking: firam na ƙarfe da ke riƙe fanalan.
- Grid-tied (haɗe da grid): a haɗe da layukan kamfanin wutar lantarki.
- Disconnect (maɓallin katsewa): maɓalli da ke yanke wuta zuwa wani sashe na tsari.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- U.S. Department of Energy: Homeowner's Guide to Going Solar
Gwada yanzu: A takarda, ku zana gida mai sauƙi da fanalai a kan rufinsa. Ku zana ku rubuta sunan akwatuna shida bisa tsari: fanalai, racking, inverter, disconnect, babban akwatin wutar lantarki, mita. Kusa da kowanne, ku rubuta gajeren layi ɗaya kan abin da yake yi. Sannan ku rufe sunayen ku faɗi kowane sashe da babbar murya.
Yanzu za ku iya faɗin sunayen manyan sassan tsarin solar da ke haɗe da grid da abin da kowanne yake yi.

check.q: Wane sashe ne yake mayar da DC daga fanalan zuwa AC don gidan?
check.why: Inverter yana mayar da DC na fanalan zuwa AC da gidaje ke amfani da shi.

options: Tsarin yana haɗe da layukan kamfanin wutar lantarki
Tsarin yana aiki da dare kawai
check.why: Tsarin grid-tied yana nan a haɗe da grid na kamfanin wuta, don haka ƙarin wuta yana iya fita, kuma wutar grid tana iya shigowa.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Kasancewa lafiya a wurin aikin solar
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Jera manyan haɗurra a aikin solar da matakin tsaro na kowanne.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku labarin aikin solar na atisaye, za ku iya jera haɗurran da matakin tsaro na kowanne, kuna ambaton faɗuwa, girgizar lantarki, zafi da ɗaukar kaya, da matakin tsaro daidai na kowanne.
Faɗuwa ita ce babbar haɗari a aikin solar. A aikin gini, OSHA tana buƙatar kariya daga faɗuwa idan kuna aiki a ƙafa 6 ko fiye sama da ƙasan da ke ƙarƙashinku. A kan rufi, yawanci wannan yana nufin tsarin kama faɗuwa na mutum (personal fall arrest system): harness na dukan jiki, lanyard (igiyar haɗi) da anga (anchor) a kan rufi, wanda ƙwararren mutum ya kafa. Ku duba harness ɗinku kafin kowane amfani.
Girgizar lantarki ita ce babbar haɗari ta biyu. Fanalan solar suna yin wutar lantarki duk lokacin da haske ya taɓa su, kuma ba za ku iya kashe rana ba. Wayoyin da ke fitowa daga fanalan suna iya ɗauke da wuta da rana ko da maɓalli a kashe yake. A matsayinku na sabon mataimaki, ba ku haɗa ko taɓa wayoyi: ƙwararrun ma'aikata masu horo ne kaɗai ke yin aikin lantarki, suna bin matakan lockout da tagout.
Tsani: ku ɗora shi a kan ƙasa mai ƙarfi da daidaito, sandunan gefensa su wuce bakin rufi da aƙalla ƙafa 3, kuma ku riƙe wurare uku a koyaushe (hannu biyu da ƙafa ɗaya, ko ƙafa biyu da hannu ɗaya). Zafi: ku riƙa shan ruwa, ku huta a inuwa, kuma ku faɗa wa shugabanku idan kuna jin jiri ko ciwo. Ɗaukar kaya: fanalai manya ne kuma iska tana kama su, don haka mutane biyu su ɗauke su, kuma ku ɗaga da ƙafafunku.
Ku sa kayan kariyarku (PPE): hular kwano, gilashin kariya, safar hannu ta aiki da takalma masu riƙo. Ku dakatar da aiki ku faɗa wa shugabanku duk lokacin da wani abu bai yi kama da lafiya ba.
Mataki-mataki:
- Kafin ku hau: ku duba tsani, yanayi da harness ɗinku.
- A kan rufi: ku kasance a ɗaure da anga duk lokacin da kuke ƙafa 6 ko fiye a sama.
- Ku ɗauki kowane fanali da waya kamar suna ɗauke da wuta; kada ku taɓa haɗin wayoyi sai idan ku ƙwararru ne.
- Ku sha ruwa, ku huta a inuwa, kuma ku ɗauki fanalai tare da abokin aiki.
- Ku tsaya ku faɗa wa shugabanku game da duk wata haɗari.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- OSHA: U.S. Occupational Safety and Health Administration, hukumar tarayyar Amurka ta tsaro a wurin aiki.
- Kariya daga faɗuwa (fall protection): kaya da tsare-tsaren da ke hana ku faɗuwa ko suke tsayar da faɗuwa lafiya.
- Personal fall arrest system: harness na dukan jiki, lanyard da anga da ke kama ku idan kun faɗi.
- PPE: personal protective equipment: kayan kariyar da kuke sawa, kamar hular kwano da safar hannu.
- Lockout/tagout: matakan kashe wuta da kulle ta don kada wani ya sake kunna ta yayin da ake aiki.
- Mai ɗauke da wuta (live): yana ɗauke da wutar lantarki.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- OSHA: Fall protection
- OSHA: 29 CFR 1926.501, duty to have fall protection (construction)
- OSHA: 29 CFR 1926.1053, ladders
- OSHA: Heat
- U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics: Solar photovoltaic installers
Gwada yanzu: Labarin atisaye: safiya ce mai zafi a watan Yuli. Ƙungiyarku tana saka fanalai 18 a kan rufin gida mai hawa biyu. Tsanin yana kan ciyawa mai laushi, wani abokin aiki ba shi da harness, kuma wayoyin wani fanali suna rataye a sake. A takarda, ku yi jerin bincike mai ginshiƙai biyu: Haɗari da Matakin tsaro. Ku rubuta aƙalla layuka huɗu (faɗuwa, girgizar lantarki, zafi, ɗaukar kaya, da tsani).
Yanzu za ku iya gane manyan haɗurra a aikin solar da faɗin matakin tsaro na kowanne.

check.q: A aikin gini, a wane tsawo ne OSHA take buƙatar kariya daga faɗuwa?
check.why: Dokar OSHA ta aikin gini tana buƙatar kariya daga faɗuwa a ƙafa 6 ko fiye sama da ƙasan da ke ƙarƙashi.

check.q: Rana tana haskakawa kuma maɓallin disconnect a kashe yake. Shin wayoyin fanali ba su da haɗarin taɓawa?
options: Eh, maɓallin yana sa komai ya zama lafiya
A'a, fanalai suna yin wuta duk lokacin da haske ya taɓa su, don haka ku ɗauki wayoyi kamar suna da wuta
Eh, idan kun sa safar hannu ta aiki
Sai dai idan inverter ba ya ƙara
check.why: Fanalai suna ci gaba da yin wuta a cikin haske, don haka wayoyinsu suna iya ɗauke da wuta har yanzu.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Lissafin solar mai sauƙi (na atisaye kawai)
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Lissafa watt, girman tsari da voltage na string daga lambobin atisaye.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku lambobin atisaye na fanalai, volt da amp, za ku iya lissafa watt, girman tsari da voltage na string, ba tare da kuskuren lissafi ba, kuna nuna yadda kuka yi.
Ƙungiyoyi suna amfani da wasu dabarun lissafi masu sauƙi kowace rana. Duk lambobin da ke cikin wannan darasi an ƙirƙira su ne don atisaye kawai. Zane na gaske yana amfani da alamar fanalin, takardar bayanin mai ƙera shi (data sheet) da ƙa'idar lantarki (electrical code), kuma ƙwararren mai zane ne ke duba shi.
Ƙarfin wuta: watts = volts x amps. Fanalin atisaye da ke yin volt 40 a amp 10 yana yin 40 x 10 = watt 400. Watt 1,000 shi ne kilowatt 1 (kW).
Girman tsari: yawan fanalai x watt na kowane fanali. Fanalan atisaye 20 masu watt 400 kowanne = watt 8,000, wato 8 kW.
Strings: fanalan da aka haɗa a jere (series) suna yin string. A series, voltage suna haɗuwa (ƙari) kuma amps suna nan daidai. Fanalan atisaye uku masu volt 40 kowanne a series = volt 120. A parallel (gefe da gefe), amps suna haɗuwa kuma voltage yana nan daidai.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku fara rubuta dabarar lissafin.
- Ku saka lambobin da alamominsu (V, A, W).
- Ku yi lissafin a na'urar lissafi.
- Ku mayar da watt zuwa kilowatt ta raba da 1,000.
- Ku duba: shin amsar tana da ma'ana?
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Volt (V): ma'aunin turawa ko matsin wutar lantarki.
- Amp (A): ma'aunin yawan wutar lantarki da ke gudana.
- Watt (W): ma'aunin ƙarfin wuta: volts sau amps.
- Kilowatt (kW): watt 1,000.
- Series: haɗawa ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshe a layi ɗaya; voltage suna haɗuwa.
- Parallel: haɗawa gefe da gefe; amps suna haɗuwa.
- String: rukunin fanalai da aka haɗa a series.
Gwada yanzu: Na atisaye kawai. Ku warware a takarda ku nuna yadda kuka yi: (a) Fanali yana yin volt 36 a amp 11. Watt nawa? (b) Gida yana da fanalai 24 masu watt 350. Mene ne girman tsarin a kW? (c) Fanalai biyar masu volt 40 kowanne an haɗa su a series. Mene ne voltage na string? Amsoshi don ku duba kanku: (a) 396 W, (b) 8,400 W = 8.4 kW, (c) 200 V.
Yanzu za ku iya lissafa watt, girman tsari da voltage na string daga lambobin atisaye da nuna yadda kuka yi.

check.q: Na atisaye kawai: fanalai 15 masu watt 400 kowanne. Mene ne girman tsarin?
Na atisaye kawai: fanalai huɗu masu volt 40 kowanne an haɗa su a series. Mene ne voltage na string?
check.why: A series voltage suna haɗuwa: 4 x 40 V = 160 V.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Daga rufi zuwa aikinku na farko

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Matakan saka solar a kan rufi
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Jera matakan saka solar a kan rufi bisa tsari da faɗin wanda yake yin kowanne.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku matakan saka solar a kan rufi a gauraye, za ku iya jera matakan bisa tsari da faɗin wanda yake yin kowanne, ba tare da mataki fiye da ɗaya ya kauce wurinsa ba.
Kowane aikin saka solar yana bin hanya. Da farko, binciken wuri (site assessment): wani yana duba shekarun rufin da yanayinsa, inda yake fuskanta, inuwar bishiyoyi, da babban akwatin wutar lantarki na gidan. Sannan mai zane yana tsara wurin fanalan da wayoyin.
Na gaba kuma izini (permit). Ofishin gine-gine na birni ko ƙaramar hukuma (county) yana duba zanen kafin a fara aiki. A ranar saka solar, ƙungiyar tana kafa kayan tsaro, tana yi wa rufin alama, kuma tana ƙulle abubuwan haɗi a cikin rafters (katakan rufi). Ana yi wa kowane abin haɗi flashing kuma a toshe shi don kada rufin ya yi yoyo. Sannan ƙungiyar tana ƙulle racking ta ɗora fanalan.
Ƙwararren mai aikin lantarki ko ma'aikaci mai lasisi ne yake yin haɗin wutar lantarki, yana bin National Electrical Code (NEC) da dokokin wurin. Sannan jami'in gine-gine na wurin yana duba tsarin (inspection). A ƙarshe, kamfanin wutar lantarki (utility) yana amincewa a haɗa tsarin da grid, wanda ake yawan kira permission to operate (izinin aiki). Sai bayan haka ne ake kunna tsarin.
Mataimaka galibi suna ɗauka da shirya kayan aiki, suna taimakawa wajen kafa racking da fanalai, suna tsaftace wurin, kuma suna bin umarnin shugaba.
Mataki-mataki:
- Binciken wuri: rufi, inda yake fuskanta, inuwa, akwatin wutar lantarki.
- Zane: tsarin wurin fanalai da shirin wayoyi.
- Izini daga birni ko ƙaramar hukuma.
- Kafa kayan tsaro, sannan abubuwan haɗi a rufi, da flashing da toshewa.
- Racking, sannan a ɗora fanalai.
- Haɗin wutar lantarki ta hannun ƙwararrun ma'aikata.
- Dubawa daga jami'in wurin.
- Amincewar kamfanin wuta (permission to operate), sannan a kunna.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Binciken wuri (site assessment): ziyara don duba ko rufi ko fili ya dace da solar.
- Izini (permit): izinin hukuma daga birni ko ƙaramar hukuma don yin aikin.
- Flashing: ƙarfe ko wani abu da ke hana ruwa shiga inda wani abu ya ratsa rufi.
- Rafter: ɗaya daga cikin katakan da ke riƙe rufi.
- NEC: National Electrical Code (NFPA 70), ƙa'idodin aikin lantarki lafiya da jihohi da birane ke ɗauka.
- Dubawa (inspection): binciken da jami'i ke yi don tabbatar da cewa aikin ya cika code.
- Permission to operate: amincewar kamfanin wuta don kunna tsarin da ke haɗe da grid.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- U.S. Department of Energy: Homeowner's Guide to Going Solar
- NFPA 70: National Electrical Code (check which edition your state uses)
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta kowane ɗaya daga cikin matakai 8 na saka solar a kan ɗan ƙaramin takarda nasa. Ku gauraya su, sannan ku sake jera su bisa tsari ba tare da kallon darasin ba. Kusa da kowanne, ku rubuta wanda yake yin sa: mai zane, birni ko ƙaramar hukuma, ƙungiya, ƙwararren mai aikin lantarki, jami'in dubawa ko kamfanin wuta. Ku kwatanta tsarinku da darasin.
Yanzu za ku iya jera matakan saka solar a kan rufi bisa tsari da faɗin wanda yake yin kowanne.

check.q: Me yake zuwa kafin ranar saka solar kai tsaye?
check.why: Izinin birni ko ƙaramar hukuma yana zuwa kafin a fara aiki a kan rufi.

check.q: Me yasa ake yi wa abubuwan haɗi a rufi flashing da toshewa?
options: Don kada rufin ya yi yoyo
Don fanalan su ƙara yin wuta
check.why: Flashing da toshewa suna hana ruwa shiga inda ƙusoshi suka ratsa rufi.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Takardun shaida, lasisi da horo
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Jera takardun shaida da lasisin aikin solar na farko a inda kuke zaune, da majiyar hukuma ta kowanne.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da shafukan intanet na hukuma na NABCEP da na jiharku, za ku iya jera takardun shaida da lasisin da ake buƙata don aikin solar na farko a inda kuke zaune, kuna ambaton shafin majiyar kowanne.
Masu saka solar da yawa suna farawa a matsayin mataimaka kuma suna koyo yayin aiki, sau da yawa daga wata ɗaya zuwa shekara ɗaya. Wasu suna fara ɗaukar gajeren kwas a kwalejin al'umma (community college), makarantar fasaha ko shirin koyon sana'a (apprenticeship). Masu aikin lantarki, masu aikin rufi da ma'aikatan gini sau da yawa suna iya shiga solar da sauri.
NABCEP (North American Board of Certified Energy Practitioners) tana ba da sanannun takardun shaidar solar. Ta farko ita ce NABCEP PV Associate. Kuna iya cancanta ta hanyar kammala kwas tare da NABCEP Associate Registered Training Provider (makarantar horo da NABCEP ta yi wa rajista), ko ta nuna aƙalla watanni shida na cikakken aikin solar, sannan ku ci jarabawar. Daga baya, ƙwararrun masu saka solar suna iya neman NABCEP Board Certification, kamar PV Installation Professional.
Jihohi ne suke tsara lasisi, da wasu birane. Wasu jihohi suna buƙatar lasisin solar ko na lantarki don wasu ayyuka; wasu ba sa buƙata. Kuɗaɗe, ƙa'idodin jarabawa da sharuɗɗa suna canjawa, don haka ku duba shafin hukuma na NABCEP da hukumar lasisi ta jiharku da kanku kafin ku biya kuɗin komai.
Wannan kwas yana shirya ku don farawa. Ba ya ba ku takardar shaida ko lasisi.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku karanta shafin shirin NABCEP Associate.
- Ku nemo makarantar horo da aka yi wa rajista ko ku ƙirga watannin aikinku na solar.
- Ku nemi hukumar lasisin 'yan kwangila ko ta lantarki ta jiharku don ƙa'idodin solar.
- Ku rubuta kowane sharaɗi da shafin da kuka same shi.
- Ku tambayi masu ɗaukar aikin solar na kusa da ku wace takardar shaida suke so.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- NABCEP: North American Board of Certified Energy Practitioners, ƙungiyar da ke ba da takardun shaidar solar.
- Takardar shaida (credential): shaida cewa kun ci jarabawa ko kun cika wani mizani.
- Lasisi (license): izini daga jiha ko birni don yin wani aiki.
- Apprenticeship: aiki mai albashi tare da horo, inda kuke koyo daga ƙwararrun ma'aikata.
- Registered training provider: makarantar da NABCEP ta lissafa a matsayin wadda aka amince ta shirya ku don jarabawarta ta associate.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- NABCEP: Associate program (PV Associate)
- NABCEP: Certifications
- U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics: How to become a solar photovoltaic installer
- CareerOneStop: License Finder
Gwada yanzu: Ku buɗe shafin shirin NABCEP Associate ku rubuta hanyoyin cancanta don PV Associate. Sannan ku nemi sunan jiharku tare da "solar contractor license" ku nemo shafin hukuma na hukumar lasisi ta jiharku (sau da yawa yana ƙarewa da .gov). Ku rubuta layi ɗaya kan abin da ya faɗa, da adireshin shafin.
Yanzu za ku iya faɗin sunan takardar shaidar NABCEP ta farko, faɗin yadda ake cancanta da ita, da nemo ƙa'idodin lasisi na jiharku a shafin hukuma.

check.q: Wace ce takardar shaidar solar PV ta farko ta NABCEP?
check.why: NABCEP PV Associate ita ce takardar shaidar solar PV ta farko.

check.q: A ina za ku duba ko jiharku tana buƙatar lasisi don aikin solar?
options: Wani rubutu a kafofin sada zumunta
Tallar wani gajeren kwas na intanet
Shafin hukuma na hukumar lasisi ta jiharku
check.why: Kowace jiha ce ke tsara lasisi, don haka shafin hukuma na hukumar jihar shi ne majiyar da za a amince da ita.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Shirin Fara Aikin Solar naku
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Rubuta Shirin Fara Aikin Solar mai ranaku da sashen ƙwarewa na résumé.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da rubuce-rubucenku daga wannan kwas, za ku iya rubuta Shirin Fara Aikin Solar mai ranaku da sashen ƙwarewa na résumé, kuna cika kowane layi na ma'aunin rubric.
Yanzu ku haɗa komai a shafi ɗaya da za ku iya kai wa shirin horo ko hirar neman aiki. Shiri mai ranaku na gaske yana nuna wa mai ɗaukar aiki cewa da gaske kuke.
Shirinku yana da sassa shida: yadda solar ke aiki da kalmominku; jerin binciken tsaro; matsalolin lissafi na atisaye guda biyu da yadda kuka yi su; matakan saka solar bisa tsari; hanyar samun takardar shaidarku da ranaku da majiyoyi; da sashen "Ƙwarewar solar" na résumé.
Don sashen résumé, ku rubuta abubuwan gaskiya da za ku iya yi yanzu, a gajerun layuka da ke farawa da kalmar aiki. Misali: "Na san sassan tsarin PV da ke haɗe da grid da yadda DC ke zama AC." "Na sami horo kan haɗurran wurin aikin solar: kariya daga faɗuwa, girgizar lantarki, zafi da ɗaukar kaya lafiya." "Ina iya lissafa girman tsari da voltage na string." Ku ƙara aikin da kuka yi a baya da ke taimakawa: gini, rufi, aikin soja, rumbun ajiyar kaya ko duk aikin da ya shafi kayan aiki, tsawo ko aiki tare.
Tsoffin sojoji da masu tarihin laifi: masu ɗaukar aikin solar da yawa suna ɗaukar mutane daga waɗannan rukunoni. Ku faɗi gaskiya a takardun neman aiki, kuma ku tambayi cibiyar neman aiki ta wurinku ko shirin taimakon masu dawowa gida game da taimakon horo.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku rubuta bayaninku na jimloli 3 zuwa 4 game da tsarin da ke haɗe da grid.
- Ku kwafo jerin binciken tsaronku daga Darasi na 2 ku kammala shi.
- Ku ƙara matsalolin lissafi na atisaye guda biyu da yadda kuka yi su.
- Ku jera matakan saka solar 8 bisa tsari.
- Ku rubuta hanyar samun takardar shaidarku da ranakun da kuke nufi da shafukan majiya.
- Ku rubuta layukan résumé 3 da ke farawa da kalmar aiki.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Résumé: gajeriyar takarda da ke jera ƙwarewarku, aikinku da horonku don masu ɗaukar aiki.
- Ranar da ake nufi (target date): ranar da kuke shirin kammala wani mataki.
- Cibiyar neman aiki (workforce center): ofishin jama'a kyauta da ke taimakon mutane su sami aiki da horo; da yawa ana kiransu American Job Centers.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- CareerOneStop: Find an American Job Center
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku yi Shirin Fara Aikin Solar naku na shafi ɗaya mai dukkan sassa shida. Ku saka rana ta gaske kusa da kowane matakin takardar shaida da na aiki, da adireshin shafin kowane sharaɗi da kuka duba. Ku karanta layukan résumé ɗinku da babbar murya kamar kuna cikin hirar neman aiki.
Yanzu za ku iya nuna wa mai ɗaukar aiki ko shirin horo rubutaccen shirin fara aikin solar, mai ranaku, majiyoyi da sashen ƙwarewa na résumé.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Yadda solar ke aiki Bayanin ya rasa inverter ko ya gauraya AC da DC. Yana ambaton fanalai, racking, inverter, disconnect, mita da grid, kuma yana faɗin abin da kowanne yake yi. Yana kuma bayyana, da kalmominsa, dalilin da yasa disconnect yake da muhimmanci don tsaro lokacin gyara, da dalilin da yasa fanalai suke da wuta duk lokacin da akwai hasken rana. Jerin binciken tsaro Ya rasa faɗuwa ko girgizar lantarki, ko bai ba da matakin tsaro ba. Ya jera faɗuwa, girgizar lantarki, zafi da ɗaukar kaya, kowanne da matakin tsaro daidai (har da kariya daga faɗuwa a ƙafa 6). Ya ƙara yadda ake kafa tsani da ƙa'idar dakatar da aiki, kuma ya faɗi wanda za a faɗa wa. Lissafin atisaye Akwai kuskuren lissafi, ko ba a nuna yadda aka yi ba. Matsalolin biyu daidai ne, tare da dabarar lissafi da alamomin ma'auni. Ya kuma duba cewa kowace amsa tana da ma'ana, kuma ya mayar da watt zuwa kW daidai. Matakan saka solar Matakai biyu ko fiye ba a wurinsu suke ba, ko an rasa izini ko dubawa. Duk matakai 8 bisa tsari, ɗaya kawai a mafi yawa ba a wurinsa ba, da wanda yake yin kowanne. Ya bayyana dalilin da yasa flashing da amincewar kamfanin wuta suke da muhimmanci. Hanyar takardar shaida Babu ranaku, ko sharuɗɗa ba tare da majiya ba. Ya ambaci NABCEP PV Associate da hanyar cancanta, da duba lasisin jiha, kowanne da ranar da ake nufi da adireshin shafi. Ya ambaci takamaiman makarantar horo mai rajista ko mai ɗaukar aiki na wurin, da shirin madadi. Sashen résumé Layukan ba su da sarari ko suna da'awar lasisi ko takardar shaidar da mai koyo ba shi da ita. Layuka uku na gaskiya da ke farawa da kalmar aiki kuma sun dace da aikin solar. Ya haɗa aikin baya (gini, aikin soja, rumbun ajiyar kaya) da ayyukan solar. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe ku sake gwadawa.
